intent.proves: An enabled scheduled task runs the repository index build add-in.
intent.scope: ScheduledTask rows with the RepositoryScheduledTaskAddIn add-in type

bindings.reason: Needs a filter on add-in type and enabled state; mcp-count has no filter.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ScheduledTask WHERE TaskEnabled = 1 AND TaskAddInTypeName LIKE 'Dynamicweb.Indexing.ScheduledTaskAddIns.RepositoryScheduledTaskAddIn%'
